edition.publication: Domenico Vallarsi and Scipione Maffei editorial text, reprinted in Jacques-Paul Migne, Patrologia Latina 26 (Paris, 1845), cols. 307-438
edition.title: Commentariorum in Epistolam ad Galatas libri tres, Vallarsi text reprinted in Patrologia Latina 26

alternate_titles: Commentariorum in epistulam Pauli apostoli ad Galatas libri III
work.author: Jerome
work.description: Jerome's three-book commentary on the Epistle to the Galatians, the fullest Latin patristic treatment of the appointed Epistle of the Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost. Book three carries Gal. 5:25-6:18. A locus is the prologue or a book, optionally with the chapter and verse of Galatians commented on.
work.title: Commentariorum in Epistolam beati Pauli ad Galatas libri tres
